items.title: 1- Study Design and Experimental Planning (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: 1- Study Design and Experimental Planning: a main subheading of 22.1.1 Components of Biostatistics, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 186-187.

blocks.text: Is mein research ka sawal banana, maqsad (objectives) tay karna, aur hypothesis (andaze wala jawab) test karne ke liye experiments ya observational studies (mushahide wali studies) ki tarteeb banana shamil hai. Is mein population chunna, variables tay karna, randomization (qura andazi se baantna), confounding factors (beech mein aa kar nateeja bigaarne wali cheezen) ko control karna aur munasib sample size nikalna bhi aata hai. Achha study design durust (valid), bharosemand (reliable) aur ghair janibdar (unbiased) nataij deta hai.
